basic_details.job_title: NIPER-Ahmedabad Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: NIPER-Ahmedabad is engaging a Project Technical Support-III in its Department of Medical Devices on the ICMR-funded project "Slit2-mediated activation of alveolar macrophages to resolve pulmonary fibrosis". The tenure is one year, with pay of Rs. 28000 + 20% HRA = Rs. 33600. The essential qualification is as per ICMR Guideline (details below). Candidates apply only through a Google form at https://forms.gle/HaJfrQ7kVEeoyYYYA on or before 30 November 2026 (Advertisement No. Project/2026/017, dated 16.11.2026).

content_sections.heading: NIPER-Ahmedabad Project Technical Support-III at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Slit2-mediated activation of alveolar macrophages to resolve pulmonary fibrosis (Project No./Code Devres/SG2025/01005/SR, dated 05-02-2026)

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post is for the ICMR-funded project on Slit2-mediated activation of alveolar macrophages to resolve pulmonary fibrosis, run in the Department of Medical Devices at NIPER-Ahmedabad. The Co-Principal Investigator is Dr. Rajesh Vasita, Associate Professor, Department of Medical Devices. The notice describes the position as purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives the essential qualification "As per ICMR Guideline". It prints the following for Project Technical Support-III. The notice does not print an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact qualification wording before applying.

rows.essential_qualification: Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject / field + three (03) Years post qualification experience or PG in Life Sciences/Biomedical Sciences/Bioengineering or equivalent. OR For Engineering - Four Years Graduate Degree in Bioengineering/Biomedical Engineering or equivalent.
rows.desirable: Experience in electrospinning/3D printing/hand on animal cell culture

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary is printed as Rs. 28000 + 20% HRA = Rs. 33600. The position is available initially for one year and may be extended further for one year based on the candidate's satisfactory performance and continuation of the project. The position is purely temporary in nature and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIPER-Ahmedabad Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Fill the online form available at https://forms.gle/HaJfrQ7kVEeoyYYYA on or before 30.11.2026. Apply only through this Google form. Applying through any other mode will not be entertained. Keep a copy of the submitted application (proof of application); it must be attached with the documents during verification. Send any further communication to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email regarding the further screening process / interview (Online/Offline). Candidates must produce all original certificates and relevant documents at the time of the selection process. The notice does not state the interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The selected candidate will be engaged purely on a temporary basis, and the position is co-terminus with the project.
